Cross-origin iframe can obtain cross-origin isolation only if parent allows via Permissions-Policy cross-origin-isolated and both documents send COOP/COEP and CORP; WebGPU access also requires ancestor not blocking via Feature-Policy and iframe allow= attribute for WebGPU not required but Permissions-Policy can block
rows.notes: Iframe needs COEP credentialless + COOP same-origin-allow-popups with crossOriginIsolated parent; WebGPU requires same-origin iframe or credentialless to avoid CORP blocking

rows.claim: Cross-origin iframe can be cross-origin isolated if embedded response has COOP/COEP and parent's Permissions-Policy allows cross-origin-isolated; Firefox enforces same as Chrome, WebGPU follows same iframe rules

Cross-origin iframe cross-origin isolation supported Safari 16.4+ only if COOP/COEP headers present and Permissions-Policy allows; WebGPU in iframe requires same-origin or COEP credentialless and may be blocked by third-party ITP
rows.notes: Safari stricter on third-party iframes for isolation and WebGPU
